intro.title: Dmitry Shestakov
intro.lead: Over 10 years building products, mostly B2B and internal systems. I write code myself, and I started out as an editor and photographer. That doesn't fit on one page, so let's flip it: you pick what matters to you, and I'll tell you only about that.
intro.question: Who are you looking for?

product.title: Product / PO
brief: Over 10 years in product, mostly B2B and internal systems: CRM, partner tools, integrations, reporting.
I run the full cycle: gather stakeholder requests, write requirements, manage the backlog and take it to release.

brief: For 10 years I owned the roadmap and backlog of a restaurant platform with a distributed development team.
Scrum and Kanban: dailies, grooming, planning; timeline planning and risk management.

product-internal.title: Internal systems
brief: I was the single point of contact for sales, the call center, editorial and partners: collecting and prioritizing their requests.
We built and launched a CRM for outbound sales in one week. I integrated Slack with telephony (Asterisk), Redmine and email, and designed the interfaces and logic of internal reporting.

product-b2b.title: B2B product
brief: Tools for restaurateurs at restorating.ru: a self-service system where restaurants keep their own listings current — 25,000 venues.
A bot platform for listings, reservations and messaging with guests, a banquet marketplace, and a contactless menu service with 100,000 dishes.

product-discovery.title: Discovery
brief: From client interviews and a prototype to release and beyond.
AI prototyping: I quickly build a working prototype myself to test a hypothesis before taking up the team's time.

delivery-migration.title: System overhaul
brief: Rebuilt the restorating.ru business logic and moved the platform from a monolith to microservices.
In parallel we launched a new website and an iOS app.

delivery-fast.title: Fast launch
brief: A CRM for outbound sales — from request to launch in one week.
As a freelancer I build end-to-end systems: interviews, requirements, prototype, development and launch. For example, Papers — a coworking and lecture management system.

delivery-bridge.title: Bridge between teams
brief: I write code myself, so I quickly turn business needs into technical solutions and discuss trade-offs with engineers in their language.
Russian native, English C2.

tech-bots.title: CRM and Telegram bots
brief: CRMs connected to Telegram bots, payment and third-party integrations, websites.
Papers — a coworking and lecture management system.

tech-llm.title: LLM and AI
brief: Built an LLM pipeline that collects and structures data from Telegram channels (Telethon, Anthropic API) — in production at libolibo.me.
I use AI tools all the time for prototypes and testing hypotheses.

tech-scale.title: Product growth
brief: libolibo.me: grew the project from a Telegram mini app, through a CMS with its own API, into a standalone PWA with tens of thousands of users.
I handle both product and development.

media-growth.title: Audience growth
brief: podfm.ru, program director: grew monthly listens from 1M to 6M in 15 months and launched new features.

media-tools.title: Product for the newsroom
brief: At restorating.ru the editorial team was one of my internal stakeholders, alongside sales, the call center and partners.
I know how a newsroom works from the inside (Time Out) and can turn its requests into requirements and a backlog.

media-text.title: Writing and communication
brief: Five years as an editor at Time Out Petersburg; St. Petersburg State University, Faculty of Journalism, Public Relations.
English C2.

events-fest.title: Festival
brief: The smelt festival in St. Petersburg. For example, BBQ Koryushka Day (2021) at Branch Garage: five chefs cooked smelt on grills, barbecues and woks.
Private parties for readers and partner events, such as “What a Summer!” with Merula.

events-award.title: Award and contest
brief: The “Best Openings of the Season” award with open public voting.
“Yes, Chef!” — a contest and photo project: we chose the most handsome chef in St. Petersburg (2019), then a Women edition and the most influential chef in Moscow (2022).

events-brand.title: Brand special project
brief: Tapas Here with Casademont: nine top chefs from St. Petersburg and Moscow created tapas, with the recipes published in a special project.
I can come up with a format that works for both the brand and the audience — and then build its interactive part myself.

photo-shoot.title: Photo shoot
brief: Portfolio and bookings — photo.dimazvali.com.
I wrote the website and the service clients use to receive their photos myself.

photo-team.title: Photo department
brief: Headed the photo department at Sobaka publishing house: shoots, selection, covers.
Plus 10 years of managing products and teams — I know how to build the process, not just the picture.

photo-project.title: Photo project
brief: At restorating.ru we ran photo projects: “Yes, Chef!” — portraits of chefs in St. Petersburg and Moscow (2019–2022), “The Secret of Form” — the most striking staff uniforms in St. Petersburg, “What a Summer” — a dozen summer terraces in a single sunny day.

final-fulltime.title: Team role
brief: Based in Tbilisi: open to office or hybrid here, remote, or relocation.

final-project.title: Project
brief: Since February 2024 I have worked as a product and technology consultant: from interviews and requirements to prototype, development and launch.

final-hello.title: Hello
brief: Great — drop me a couple of lines about yourself or your task on Telegram, I reply fast.
